title: Promote knowledge for Microsoft-owned review skills
summary: Twenty-nine knowledge articles and fifty-six sample files were moved from the Community layer to the Microsoft layer in the quality rules repository to keep skill ownership aligned with knowledge authority.
key_points: Knowledge articles for data modeling, events, performance, security, UI, and web services moved to Microsoft layer
Community layer no longer contains Microsoft-endorsed review skill knowledge
Files are pure renames with no content changes
Keeps canonical knowledge authority co-located with owned review skills
Agents corpus remains in Community alongside community-owned skills
quote: promotes 29 knowledge articles and 56 companion samples from Community into the Microsoft layer
